purpose: Map the existing manual record/comment-only route to a future isolated receiver. This file is not read by upstream runtime code and cannot authorize deployment.
approvedTargetRequired: <approval-required: one newly created sandbox repository; never 123oqwe/openclaw3.0 during first integration>

actualUpstreamConsumers.requiredForkChange: Add exactly one explicit sandbox target profile with apply_close_rules.issue and apply_close_rules.pull_request both empty. Do not add a generic 123oqwe fallback or dashboard inventory membership.
Fetch the pinned receiver's own target registry rather than openclaw/clawsweeper, use the self-owned App client ID, and admit only the explicit sandbox profile.

Retain workflow_dispatch exact item selection and only the durable queue repository_dispatch type required for its receipt. Require manual_explicit plus queue decision sourceAction=manual_explicit_review and publicationPolicy=record_comment_only before review. Remove all schedule entries, target-sweep/generic event intake, apply inputs/jobs, planning fanout, and every route that can select plan/apply/repair behavior.

Set EXACT_REVIEW_MANUAL_PUBLICATION_ENABLED=1 only after the compatible review-only consumer and publisher are deployed and Hosted-tested; it makes manual admission advertise and enforce record_comment_only.

Keep model executor token read-only. Replace stock publisher token (contents/issues/pull-requests write) with the narrow comment-only call path and prove by Hosted test that Issues:write alone publishes the PR issue comment; otherwise stop rather than grant Contents:write. Keep App key/HMAC inaccessible to model job.

nonGoals: No target dispatcher, webhook event intake, schedule, generic owner fallback, dashboard, state projection repository, apply target, repair, close, label, push, merge, or automatic onboarding.
No claim that a JSON false value disables a stock workflow path.
acceptance: The future receiver patch must first produce Hosted RED against a real entrypoint for each prohibited route and then Hosted GREEN. Until then this is a mapping draft only.
